name: New Horizons
source:
Astronomers predict that the surface temperature on Earth will fall to -230°C in a decade.

ARBOR CITY -- Three days ago, Earth was pulled away from its orbit around the Sun by a supermassive black hole. Earth is currently on a trajectory out of the solar system and into interstellar space. With that, surface temperatures are expected to fall gradually within the coming months and years.

All citizens are to remain within their assigned Habitats until further notice. Thank you for your cooperation.

[i]This message is brought to you by the World Space Administration.[/i]

[From [url=https://matchiii15.itch.io/new-horizons]itch.io[/url]]
